name: magic-card
title: Magic Card
blurb: Card with theme-aware pointer-tracked gradient glow (gradient or orb mode).
description: A container with two rendering modes: gradient (radial glow) or orb (animated rotating glow). Gradient/glow position follows pointer. Theme-aware color defaults adapt to light/dark.
use_when: Hero sections, premium feature cards, or interactive showcases where animated glows create visual magic and brand…
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where pointer tracking won't work, or accessibility-critical flows where motion should be reduced.
a11y: Card is a container; children are independent. Glow effects are purely visual. No prefers-reduced-motion guard; animations always play.
